note: Every loot table of upstream's data pack rolled 'rolls' times with LootTable#getRandomItems(params, RandomSource.create(seed ^ id.hashCode())). Default context: origin (8.5, 64, 8.5) in gloamingforest:gloaming_forest; this_entity = the table's entity for entities/<type>[/...] (else a fake player); killer, direct killer and last damage player = a fake player (player attack) with an empty hand; block_state = the default state of blocks/<block>; tool = empty hand. Per item: present = rolls containing it, total = items over all rolls, min/max = per-roll count when present (statistics, not exact rules: compare with a tolerance). variants: the same rolls (same seed) with the fake player holding variantStacks[name] - blocks/*: shears, a silk touch pickaxe, a fortune III pickaxe (also passed as the tool); entities/*: a looting III sword (the killer's weapon). A variant whose statistics equal the default is listed in variantsSameAsDefault instead.
